A '''software of probabilities,''' also known as '''probabilities program''' and '''probabilities software,''' was a technology used to find patterns from an array of data.

In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], [[Svivreni]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] [[Tyro Caladian]] used a software of probabilities to discover [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sano Sauro]]'s secret meeting places. He found that Sauro was already holding a secret meeting at that time.
